sourceData.mnemonic: An <kanji>imitation</kanji> <kanji>manner</kanji> is something that does something in the manner of something else. Imitation over and over and over. Make it into a <vocabulary>pattern</vocabulary>.
sourceData.readingMnemonic: This is a jukugo word, which usually means on'yomi readings from the kanji. Since you didn't learn the on'yomi for <ja>様</ja> with the kanji, here's a mnemonic to help you out. You see a pattern in your <reading>yo</reading>gurt (<ja>よう</ja>). The yogurt is an imitation of life. So deep, man. So deep.
